description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate game UI skill icons arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, in this order left to right then top to bottom, each centered in its own cell: a single steel sword with one white curved slash arc; a huge greatsword chopping down into a white-yellow impact star; a sword lunging point-first along one long straight white streak; a sword blade splitting an iron helmet cleanly in two; a large pale white crescent energy wave flying to the right; a gold crosshair reticle with a bright four-point star at its center; three stacked bold red upward chevrons, a symmetric rising power symbol; a cracked red heart with an upright steel sword planted through it; three golden light swords plunging point-down in a fan. Color theme: bright polished steel with crimson and gold accents. Chunky pixel art icons in the same style as the reference, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, bold readable silhouettes, every icon fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frames, no borders

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky pixel art UI icons, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, one icon centered per grid cell on magenta. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
